description: ATM-Bench: A benchmark for long-term personalized memory QA spanning ~4 years of multimodal data (images, videos, emails). Features referential queries, evidence-grounded answering, and multi-source reasoning. Paper: "According to Me: Long-Term Personalized Referential Memory QA"
